repository_statistics.definition: 64 public GitHub repositories (22 original source repositories + 42 maintained open-source forks). Historical EXP-2026-011/012 audits also included 5 private/archived repositories (69 total).

canonical_facts.claim: The Rust workspace consists of 5 crates (factory-core, factory-application, factory-infrastructure, factory-mcp-server, factory-cli) on Rust Edition 2024.

The Hatchet mission workflow executes 5 durable steps (rustant-plan, zeroclaw-execute, zeroclaw-validate, rustant-review, factory-deliver) triggered after Kafka mission-input ingestion, runtime-verified on v0.3.4 via Hatchet run e07c7bc1-3164-4460-99c1-3473cd842150 (diag-mission-1794303600-1794303618).

Untrusted execution routes through SandboxDriver and Kubernetes Jobs in factory-sandboxes/development using RuntimeClass=gvisor (runsc), PodSecurity restricted, and fail-closed zero-trust admission across all environments.
Four human-in-the-loop (HITL) decision vertices are defined; Vertex 4 (manual PR review and merge) is enforced in code while Vertices 1-3 remain in Designed status.
All EU AI Act and SOC 2 controls are architectural readiness measures; no third-party certification is claimed.
